|game_text=Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. [Vader] cards never deploy unless [[Rise Of The Dark Lord]] on table. Once per turn, if at a site you control, may apply his ability to draw battle destiny elsewhere. May not be [[Disarmed]]. Immune to [[Clash Of Sabers]] and attrition < 5.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man]]; it is the current text. Other errata versions: [[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image here is the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-darthvadermoremachinethanman-pre.gif]], marked E), which shows this text, as does the Master List slip.
* '''Original''' ([[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010): “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. [Vader] cards never deploy unless Rise Of The Dark Lord on table. Once per turn, if at a site you control, may apply his ability to draw battle destiny elsewhere. Immune to Clash Of Sabers, Disarmed, and attrition < 5.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The slip prints the pilot icon with “3.” (written out here as “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots.”) and the [Vader] icon.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “Immune to Clash Of Sabers, Disarmed, and attrition < 5.” to “Immune to Clash Of Sabers and attrition < 5. May not be Disarmed.”: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. [Vader] cards never deploy unless Rise Of The Dark Lord on table. Once per turn, if at a site you control, may apply his ability to draw battle destiny elsewhere. Immune to Clash Of Sabers and attrition < 5. May not be Disarmed.”<ref name="cl-1271_2-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) moved “May not be Disarmed.” in front of the immunity: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. [Vader] cards never deploy unless Rise Of The Dark Lord on table. Once per turn, if at a site you control, may apply his ability to draw battle destiny elsewhere. May not be Disarmed. Immune to Clash Of Sabers and attrition < 5.”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee card image (marked E) prints the same text. The Players Committee posted this text on its rules forum on 21 March 2011, as an addition to Appendix A of the Advanced Rulebook<ref name="pcforum-p608385">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 21 March 2011 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p608385 forum post])</ref>. That is earlier than the first archived copy of the card-list wording (PC-E1, 21 July 2012), whose own date is not known.
